title: J. Willard Gibbs: Scientific Papers Volume I, Old-Physics Modern LaTeX Working Editions
description:
Dedicated old-physics author record for source-scan-backed modern LaTeX working editions of selected material from J. Willard Gibbs, The Scientific Papers of J. Willard Gibbs, Volume I.

Current coverage: pp. 001-032, Graphical Methods in the Thermodynamics of Fluids; pp. 033-054, A Method of Geometrical Representation of the Thermodynamic Properties of Substances by Means of Surfaces; and pp. 055-134, the opening continuation of On the Equilibrium of Heterogeneous Substances. This is continuous for the currently staged Volume I tranche through printed page 134, but it is not a complete edition of all Gibbs scientific papers.

New in this version: adds GibbsV1_P3_p125_134.zip, a compact source-scan-backed working continuation for printed pp.125-134, plus reader-facing cumulative PDF/TeX surfaces for Paper 3 pp.055-134. The package includes installment and cumulative TeX/PDF/source-scan files, formula inventories, table inventories, scan maps, unit JSONL, compile QC, repair log, notation notes, method notes, and SHA256 manifest.

Work level: source-scan-backed working LaTeX drafts. OCR is used as a witness layer only; the source scan remains authoritative for formulae, notation, figures, tables, and final proofreading. This is not a certified critical edition.

Corrections and collaboration. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
version: 2026-06-24 Gibbs Volume I Paper 3 continuation through printed page 134
notes: Adds GibbsV1_P3_p125_134.zip and fronts the updated Paper 3 cumulative reader PDF/TeX for pp.055-134. Current public working coverage is continuous through Volume I printed page 134. Working/source-witnessed draft only; not a complete Gibbs corpus or certified critical edition.
